items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Bowie, the Zelmer had about, I'd say eleven or twelve. All that was a big band.

ctx.x: How big were these other bands?

What, the orchestra? No, at the different places like Bowie. Oh Bowie, well they had, them fellas had a good large band too. They must have about twelve pieces, and Bowie, the Zelmer had about, I'd say eleven or twelve. All that was a big band.
We might as well get those names and instruments together in Raceland. Who played which instrument?
